#### Standard Project Acceptance Criteria

- [ ] **Shift-Left Testing**: Covered by tests as far to the left as technically possible (`unit` > `integration` > `e2e` > manual hardware).
- [ ] **Code Coverage**: Meets or exceeds the 80% SonarQube threshold on new code.
- [ ] **Quality Gates**: `npm run lint`, `npm run type-check`, and `npm run format:check` pass cleanly.
- [ ] **Documentation**: User-facing documentation (`docs/`) and/or developer documentation (ADR / setup guides) updated.
- [ ] **Backlog Pruning**: `BACKLOG.md` pruned of this item in the resolving PR (if tracked).
